title: abandon path calls git checkout main best-effort; on a dirty worktree the check…
body: abandon path calls git checkout main best-effort; on a dirty worktree the checkout can silently fail leaving HEAD on the cam/* branch. The failure mode is safe (the next plan tick re-detects the branch conflict and re-pauses rather than clobbering), but a follow-up could surface the failed checkout to the operator instead of silently re-pausing.
